observations: Photo 0 shows the head of a sewing machine with a black decorative plate and a red-orange cabinet.
Photo 1 shows the same machine head with a clear plastic cover over the needle area and a pink-handled tool.
Photo 2 shows the full head of the machine with 'TWO LION' written in gold lettering on the side of the black plate.
The machine head is mounted on a brown wooden table.
A watermark 'HARDEX HARTARINDA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 show the head in good cosmetic condition, but the overall machine's functionality and the cabinet's condition are not shown.

claims.claim: Two Lion black head sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows the brand name 'TWO LION' on the machine head.
The seller's location is not confirmed by the photos.
The photos show only the head of the machine.

risks.risk: The machine may not stitch or may have a broken needle.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation with a piece of fabric being sewn.

risks.risk: The cabinet may be damaged or have rust.
risks.proof: A photo of the cabinet with the machine head removed.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing essential parts like the foot pedal or bobbin case.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included parts.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation showing the needle moving and fabric being sewn.
Photo of the cabinet with the machine head removed to check for damage.
Photo of the bobbin case and foot pedal if they are included.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Two Lion sewing machine head. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
